heading: ### 9.146 CCO-R0：所有producer・有界parser・独立expectedの限定実証

inventory.ownership: source-holder-and-managed-frame; not a VM heap/reference upper bound
coreAliases: CoreHandle === window; no new handle or core selector
commandBorrows: capture: builder + slab; then S2 table/source=slab
normalize: slab + S0 + S2 table/source=S0; clear S2 before expected
expected: independent core + S0 + S1; S2 table/source=S1 for complete check
compare: S0 + S1 + retained slab, no live S2 index
hash: chunk subarray + native hash until synchronous update returns
parser: bounded recursive frames, token/key descriptors and small key span/add closure
bootstrapBorrows: caller input/config and data-only context/groups copy until constructor returns
legacy context validation/canonical and width recipe outside command path
separate builder/expected cores built from copied input; no fresh planner independence claim
afterClose: zero and verify all registered buffers, clear parser/core token source, abort sink
readonly clock/budget/hook/tickets, empty control arrays, numeric trace and diagnostic digests can remain on closed owner
unproved: complete work model and real parent/child ledger coexistence
observer trace and exported oracle copies outside the representation proof

sites.role: data-only exception reason, no getter or coercion
clear prior binding before input preflight
